Metadata.title: AboutSelphy — streamer & creator
Metadata.description: AboutSelphy is a streamer and content creator. Find out who I am, what I stream, when I'm live, and how brands can work with me.

overview.intro: This is where the website's content gets managed. Sections switch on here as they're built.

sections.about: Edit the About text and bio, in German and English.
sections.schedule: Weekly stream plan, cancellations and extra streams.
sections.partners: Manage past partners, brand deals and sponsor packages for the media kit.
sections.inquiries: Read and answer sponsor inquiries sent through the media kit.
sections.stats: Check when the YouTube and Twitch numbers were last synced.
sections.games: Add games, set their status and order for “What I play”.

about.intro: The text on the home page. English and German are edited side by side; both are required.
about.adminOnly: Only admins can edit the profile. Ask the owner if something needs to change.
about.taglineHint: One sentence under your name. Also used for search results.
about.bioHint: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
about.saved: Profile saved. The home page shows the new text now.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can save the profile.
errors.invalid: Some fields aren't valid. Check the marked fields.
errors.failed: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.

stats.intro: The numbers behind the media kit. A sync runs every 5 minutes; slow-moving numbers are refreshed hourly.
stats.syncedWithErrors: Sync finished with errors. See the latest run below.
stats.syncForbidden: You need to be signed in as staff.
stats.noData: No data yet. Run a sync.
stats.twitchNote: Twitch has no API for average viewers, so these come from our own samples every 5 minutes while live.
stats.noStreams: No streams sampled yet. Numbers appear after the next stream.

games.intro: The games shown under “What I play” on the home page, in this order.
games.adminOnly: Only admins can change the games.
games.empty: No games yet. Add the first one.
games.name: Name
games.blurbHint: One or two sentences, shown under the game name.
games.tagsHint: Comma-separated, up to 6 (e.g. Hourglass PvP, Tucking). Shown as-is in both languages.
games.confirmText: It disappears from the home page right away. This can't be undone.

errors.tagTooLong: Each tag can have at most 30 characters.

games.twitchCategoryHint: The cover image comes from Twitch. Leave empty if the game has the same name on Twitch; otherwise enter its exact Twitch name (e.g. “Hunt: Showdown 1896”).
games.noCover: No cover found on Twitch – check the Twitch category name.
games.coverHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF, up to 4 MB. Cropped to 3:4.
games.shownOnHome: {name} is shown on the home page
games.hiddenFromHome: {name} is hidden from the home page

schedule.intro: The weekly plan repeats automatically. Use changes to cancel a single stream or add an extra one. Times are Vienna time.
schedule.titleHint: Optional. Shown next to the game. Write @name to link a Twitch channel.
schedule.activeHint: Paused streams stay saved but don't appear on the site.
schedule.noSlotOnDate: No weekly stream on that day.
schedule.confirmDeleteSlot: Delete this weekly stream? Its cancellations are removed too.

errors.weekdayMismatch: That stream doesn't happen on this date.

Streams.metaDescription: Watch AboutSelphy live on Twitch – Sea of Thieves Hourglass PvP, Hunt: Showdown and more – plus past broadcasts, top clips and Shorts on YouTube.
Streams.title: Streams & videos
Streams.intro: Live on Twitch, highlights and Shorts on YouTube. Players load only when you press play.
Streams.offlineText: Follow on Twitch to get notified when the next stream starts.
Streams.vodsNote: Twitch keeps broadcasts only for a limited time.

Schedule.metaDescription: When AboutSelphy is live on Twitch: this week's stream plan – Sea of Thieves, Hunt: Showdown and more, with cancellations and extra streams in your time zone.
Schedule.title: Stream schedule
Schedule.intro: This week on Twitch. Times are shown in your time zone.
Schedule.empty: No streams planned for this week yet.
Schedule.followHint: Follow on Twitch to get notified when a stream starts.

Inquiry.heading: Work with me
Inquiry.intro: Tell me about your brand and what you have in mind. I read every inquiry and answer by email, usually within a few days.
Inquiry.messageHint: What would you like to do together? Timeframe, product, format.
Inquiry.privacy: I only use your details to answer this inquiry. They're stored for at most 12 months after it's closed and never shared. Write to me any time to have them deleted.
Inquiry.successText: I'll get back to you by email soon.

MediaKit.metaDescription: Work with AboutSelphy: audience numbers from Twitch and YouTube, past partners and packages – and a form to send a sponsorship inquiry.

MediaKit.intro: Who watches, how many, and how to work together. The numbers below come straight from Twitch and YouTube and update on their own.
